title: Same brief, HyperFrames vs Remotion, vendor skills only
summary: Two fresh Claude agents get one fixed 20 s brief, one with the HyperFrames skills and one with the Remotion Agent Skills, and render locally with no human help.
verified: Both arms ran on 2026-11-12 on an Apple M3 Max (64 GB, macOS), Node 22, ffmpeg 7.1.1. Agent under test: a Claude subagent per arm, one run each. measure.py was run on both delivered files by the driver.
runtime: about 2 s per clip to measure; the agent runs took 7 min 46 s and 11.0 min
key_result: Both arms pass the stream and stillness thresholds fixed before the run. One blind reviewer scored the Remotion clip 10/12 and the HyperFrames clip 8/12 on a six-point rubric (judgement, n = 1 per arm).
threshold: Per arm: readable MP4, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 20.0 s +/- 0.5 s, h264, no black segment over 1.0 s after the first 0.5 s, no frozen segment over 4.0 s, delivered within 30 min with no human message.
